players.product: antibody discovery and multispecific T-cell engager platform

quarterly_data.signal: 10-K table of molecules in the clinic as of December 31, 2025: AbCellera-led ABCL635 (Endocrinology / Women's Health; VMS associated with menopause) at Phase 1/2 and ABCL575 (Immunology & Inflammation; atopic dermatitis) at Phase 1. Partner-led molecules include ABD-147 from Abdera Therapeutics Inc. (Oncology) at Phase 1 with Fast Track and orphan drug designations, an undisclosed Teva Pharmaceutical Industries Ltd. neuroscience molecule at Phase 1, TAK-920/DNL919 from Denali Therapeutics Inc. (Neurology) at Phase 1, and Dechra Pharmaceuticals/Invetx animal-health molecules in pivotal studies and clinical field studies (including IVX-01); TAK-920/DNL919 and Eli Lilly's bamlanivimab and bebtelovimab (marketed, EUA) are expected to make no further progress or reach no ultimate approval. Trianni-licensed molecules include Arsenal Bio's AB-2100 (Phase 1/2) and AB-3028 (IND authorized), GigaGen's GIGA-564 (Phase 1), and NovaRock Biotherapeutics molecules (NBL-012, NBL-015/FL-301, NBL-020, NBL-028) whose Phase 1 studies are paused.
quarterly_data.figure: ABCL635 Phase 1/2; ABCL575 Phase 1; ABD-147 Phase 1 (Fast Track- and orphan drug-designated); AB-3028 IND authorized; NovaRock NBL-012, NBL-015/FL-301, NBL-020, NBL-028 Phase 1 (paused)
